Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

r4agent 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • agent_suite(), agent_case(), agent_thresholds() and read_agent_suite() define a benchmark suite: cases with an expected answer, a slice and a severity, plus the slice thresholds agreed before a run.
  • run_benchmark() runs an agent or language model against the suite and score_slices() grades the results locally and deterministically, with no model called to judge another model.
  • readiness() returns a production readiness answer, consistency() checks run-to-run stability, and diff_runs() surfaces a case that used to pass and now fails instead of averaging it away.
  • agent_evidence() emits the results as R4SUB evidence rows via ‘r4subcore’, and report_markdown() writes a shareable report.
  • register_grader() and graders_available() expose the pluggable, offline grader interface.

Developed by Pawan Rama Mali.
